corpus.use: W1 prefill rate, W3 prefill half of the 240k decode leg
W2 144k decode (one prefill + 1024 generated), W4 2x2 decode shape
W2 short-PP 2k and the TTFT leg's turn-1 prompt

could_not_build: No boot, no leg and no measurement was run: the fixer lane is CPU-only, prod is serving, and the windows are operator-gated.

The 2x2 verdicts are STATIC (binary literal scan + server argv model). The servers' drafting chooser was not executed; its no-op outcome for these names is asserted from the regex in both trees and must be confirmed from the first boot line.
W4's optional third boot per cell (min p 0.10) is planned but not prepared; 2 boots per cell is what the budget covers.

Short-PP/TTFT pilot deltas are not pre-registered here: the contract requires the pilot legs to run first and their deltas to be written into this manifest before the claim legs. The pilot section marks where they land.
deviations: The arms cannot be byte-identical: arm B carries --conversation-spill-mib 0 and arm A has no such option. That is the declared structural difference, not a lever.

model_name is matched to 'ud-iq3_xxs' and reasoning_budget_tokens to 0: the adopted bases served different values (A 55,000 / B 2,000 and two names); neither name matches a drafter regex in either server, so drafting.apply leaves the args untouched.
A base's --conversation-cache-dir pointed into the helper-ipc worktree; both arms now use a fresh per-leg directory under the harness tree.
W2's budget is derived here for the first time (the contract required it at harness-prep once legs-per-boot was frozen).
